Hannah — thanks again for the renewal chat yesterday. Fieldstone would like to expand the existing contract to cover four additional projects across Product, Clinical AI, Integrations, and Search. High-level asks: we need 4 additional API key namespaces, a planned capacity increase to ~5M tokens/month (spread across the teams), and an aligned renewal amendment that bumps the committed capacity and adjusts term dates (we prefer a Jan 1 effective date).

Can you send a mutual action plan and a quote that shows pro-rated pricing for the remainder of this term and the new committed rate beginning 2028? Also happy to do a 2-week canary for one app before we activate the rest. Procurement (Rajiv) is looping in contract requirements.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Jones

Thanks — quick technical notes from the provisioning side so we set expectations up front:

- Keys: we'll create four new API key namespaces (one per project) plus a sandbox key. Keys will be namespaced by project-id; we recommend rotating the keys after the canary period.
- Rate limits & capacity: default burst limit is 60 rps per key; for the Clinical AI canary we can raise soft limits to 120 rps during the 2-week window to reduce headroom issues.
- Caching & batching: recommend enabling prefix KV caching and a shared cache bucket for the Integrations team to reduce token consumption on repeated prompts.
- Pre-provision checklist: I've attached prod-rollout-checklist.md with required test cases and telemetry flags we need enabled before go-live.

I'll coordinate the exact provisioning windows with Ops once we have the confirmed start dates.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
